title: The Union of South Africa is formed
summary: The Cape, Natal, Transvaal and Orange River colonies were united into the Union of South Africa, a self-governing British dominion with Louis Botha as prime minister.
reason: After the Boer War, British and Boer leaders sought a unified state, built on a settlement that excluded most black Africans from political power.
significance: It founded the modern South African state and entrenched the racial order that led to apartheid.
